_README: Click targets for the Recipe B input-automation loop. EVERY coordinate here is a PLACEHOLDER and MUST be calibrated live with `sims4ctl calibrate` before driving the real game. See docs/RECIPE_B.md section 'Calibration'.

_schema.window_title_substr: Case-insensitive substring matched against the game window title. The live German title is 'Die Sims™ 4'; 'Sims' matches all locales.
_schema.target: Each clickable target is EITHER {"norm": [x, y]} with x,y in [0,1] as a fraction of the CLIENT rect, OR {"template": "path/to/crop.png", "threshold": 0.85} matched with OpenCV. If both keys are present, the template is tried first and 'norm' is the fallback. 'enabled': false skips an optional step (e.g. the MODS dialog when it doesn't appear).
_schema.templates_dir: Directory (relative to this file) where button-template PNGs captured by `calibrate` live.

mods_dialog_dismiss._comment: Startup MODS-notice close [X]. CALIBRATED on 4K@150%, client 2023x1138 (norm of the X, dialog centered on the window). ENABLED because this install has 'Bei Start zeigen' checked, so the dialog appears every launch. NOTE: norm-only always clicks; if you uncheck show-at-startup (no dialog), add a 'template' crop of the X so locate returns None when absent, or set enabled:false.

continue._comment: Main-menu 'Spiel fortsetzen' (Continue = load most-recent save). CALIBRATED on 4K@150%, client 2023x1138 (screen approx 210,793); verified end-to-end -> save loaded, bridge heartbeat in ~6s. Single-click default for `load-save --continue`.

load_game._comment: Main-menu 'Spiel laden' (Load Game) -> opens the save picker. PLACEHOLDER. Used by `load-save --slot N`.

load_confirm._comment: The 'Spielen'/confirm button inside the save picker once a slot thumbnail is selected. PLACEHOLDER.

new_game._comment: Main-menu 'Neues Spiel' (New Game). PLACEHOLDER. Used by the optional `new-game` command.

save_slots._comment: Per-slot thumbnail targets inside the Load-Game picker, keyed by slot id (decimal string). PLACEHOLDER single example for the reserved test slot 255 (0xFF). Add entries as you calibrate each slot's thumbnail position. `load-save --slot N` clicks slots[str(N)] then 'load_confirm'.
